question.text: A Cat III AIF scheme that accepts investors other than accredited investors must ensure a minimum investment of:

answer.text: Rs. 1 crore per investor (except for Accredited Investors)

explanation.text: The Logic: A Category III AIF scheme that accepts investors other than accredited investors must ensure a minimum investment of Rs. 1 crore per investor. Accredited investors have the prescribed carve-out from this Rs. 1 crore minimum. The Trap: Rs. 25 lakh is the employee/director exception within the Cat III AIF framework, not the general investor minimum. Rs. 50 lakh is shown in the source as the PMS minimum, not the Cat III AIF investor minimum. Rs. 5 crore is not the prescribed threshold. Note: Accredited investor status is supported by accreditation certificates and verification of accredited-investor status as described in the source.
